notes.note: Steele was better this week after a couple of lower scores. 27 touches and 7 tackles to go with a goal.
12 of his 17 were handballs and he had 12 contested possessions. Many teams are stuck with him through lack of trades but if you can loop him it would be the best option.
Steele was down having his lowest score of the season by some distance. Just 5 kicks with 11 handballs at 68%. A disappointing result with the Demons getting the win.
Steele racked up 30 touches and led the game with 12 contested possessions. He got off to a hot start with 42 in the first but just 11 in the last when the game was there to be won.
Steele had a slow start but ended with 23 disposals and 8 marks. He hasn't been posting the big scores we want but is doing just enough to be your M8 or M9.
Huge outing for Steele with 10 tackles to go with his 27 disposals and 8 clearances. This is what we have been waiting for! His second best score for the season.
Steele has been better of late despite not hitting the 100 mark. 21 disposals and 8 tackles for him. You may be stuck with him and if so this makes him your M8.

Steele had a role to run with Dawson and he restricted the Crows superstar whilst picking up 21 disposals of his own. He is still one that we should be trying to upgrade on his bye next week if we have the trades available.
This was Steele's best score in the last three and back to back 90s for him. He is just doing enough and if you are running out of trades he may need to stick around as your M8.
Steele is one that we have been looking at trading out. This was his second best score in the last 6 but just one score over 100 in that time also means you can certainly look at upgrading him.

20 of his 25 disposals were handballs and he had 13 contested possessions. This was his lowest in the last four weeks. He just isn't delivering scores that we had hoped for. He is one you can trade at his bye.

This was the best output we have had from Steele since round 4. The key to this weeks game was 10 tackles and had a 21 disposals at 90% efficiency. A great turnaround in form when many were looking to move him on.

Steele topped the game in contested possessions with 14 to go with his 26 disposals and was able to post his best in the last three weeks. He has slowed in scoring but he won't be your biggest issue this week.
21 of his 26 disposals were handballs this week at 69%. This was his second under 90 in a row and three of the last four under 100 which is a concern.
This was Steele's lowest for the season. Just 4 of his 19 were kicks. He saved his score with 11 contested possessions and 6 clearances. He won't be your biggest concern.
Steele just keeps delivering with 25 disposals this week at 80%. His scoring is consistent and that is all we can ask for.
Steele was 1 point shy of his 100 last week. He is still consistently scoring and is not one of your concerns.
Many had Steele as a VC or C but with the Bombers winning we didn't see a huge score from Jack. 28 disposals for him to be one of just two Dees with 100 or more.
Steele is continuing to show some great form with his 26 disposals and 8 tackles. Nothing to worry about with him as he led the game in both Contested possessions and clearances.
Steele hasn't let us down yet despite what some people have said. His game included an impressive 16 tackles!
Steele was better this week and showed us what he is capable of as one of just three Demons to hit the 100.  9 tackles were the key for Jack along with his 31 disposals. Hold for now.
Steele gave us pretty much what we expected which was the third highest for the Dees this week. 21 disposals and a goal. However he did look slow which is a concern. He won't be a long term play.
